propositions: Record an ADR (0100) documenting the approved CLI command registry, lazy handler routing, and capability enforcement architecture before implementation begins
The ADR must establish stdlib-only argparse as the single source for both runtime parsing and generated help, with no separate docs DSL or parser framework
Pre-operation routing must occur before RP-04 snapshot, config, mount, and handler composition, with help/alias/unknown resolution at the top level
The ADR must define the alias taxonomy (canonical, exact, compatibility, hidden, retired) and capability postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) without contradicting ADR 0098
ADR numbering must resolve to 0100 (since 0099 was taken by binding-store ADR), with generated index and marker files validated by check_adr_numbers.py and gen_adr_index.py
The maintainer approved the exact design on 2026-08-18; the ADR must record that end state verbatim and land in Gerrit with both gates passing before any implementation work begins
